skill.name: modelarts-skill
skill.description: Integrates Huawei Cloud ModelArts operations for notebooks, training jobs, inference services, resource pools, VPC, KMS, SWR, and Lite Server management.
skill.summary: Manage Huawei Cloud ModelArts resources through focused operational modules.
skill.author: modelarts-agent

security_audit.summary: The audit confirms real high-risk cloud credential handling and signed outbound Huawei Cloud API calls. Most shell execution, dynamic import, system reconnaissance, hardcoded IP, and key-file static hits are false positives from Markdown, docstrings, static imports, or resource identifiers. Semantic review also found high-risk training command execution, broad cloud administration, and IAM authorization capabilities.

remediation.suggestion: Keep credentials out of responses and logs, add automated redaction tests, and document least-privilege IAM requirements for every module.
Require explicit confirmation before submitting command-based jobs, validate trusted images, and restrict commands to reviewed operational patterns.
Require confirmation for create, update, delete, start, stop, scale, batch, and authorization actions, especially in production workspaces.
Document all Huawei Cloud endpoints, supported regions, timeout behavior, and required permissions for VPC, KMS, SWR, and ModelArts requests.

content.value_statement: ModelArts teams need safe, repeatable help for notebooks, training jobs, inference services, and cloud resources. This skill routes requests to focused ModelArts modules and returns operational results.
actual_capabilities: Authenticates to ModelArts through Notebook sessions or supplied AK/SK parameters.
Lists, creates, updates, starts, stops, and deletes notebooks, training jobs, and inference services.
Queries resource pools, node pools, Lite Server instances, hyper clusters, flavors, and images.
Uses signed requests for VPC, KMS keypair, and SWR image repository queries.
Manages workspace, authorization, tags, leases, and scheduled event operations.
limitations: Requires valid Huawei Cloud credentials and matching service permissions.
Create, update, delete, start, and stop actions can change resources or incur costs.
Does not provide an independent approval workflow or policy engine.
Direct API support depends on installed Huawei SDK packages and regional service availability.

use_cases.title: Operate ModelArts Workspaces
use_cases.description: List notebooks, jobs, services, pools, and workspace settings before routine platform maintenance.

use_cases.title: Prepare Training Runs
use_cases.description: Compare images, flavors, pools, storage paths, and runtime settings before creating a training job.

use_cases.title: Review Cloud Dependencies
use_cases.description: Inspect VPCs, subnets, security groups, KMS keypairs, and SWR repositories used by ModelArts workloads.

prompt_templates.title: List Current Notebooks
prompt_templates.prompt: List my ModelArts notebooks in workspace 0. Summarize status, flavor, lease, and any stopped instances.

prompt_templates.title: Plan A Notebook Change
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a notebook update plan using an existing image and OBS storage. Ask for confirmation before any create or update action.

prompt_templates.title: Choose Training Resources
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare available training flavors and resource pools. Recommend a production setup for my training job and explain the tradeoffs.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Workspace Dependencies
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my ModelArts workspace dependencies. List notebooks, training jobs, inference services, VPCs, subnets, security groups, and risky open access.

output_examples.input: Show all running notebooks and explain which ones may need attention.
output_examples.output: A status summary with notebook names, IDs, workspace, flavor, lease state, and recommended follow-up actions.

output_examples.input: Prepare a production training job from my chosen image and OBS paths.
output_examples.output: A validated job plan with selected image, resource pool, flavor, storage paths, and a confirmation request before creation.

output_examples.input: Review network resources that may affect ModelArts access.
output_examples.output: A concise inventory of VPCs, subnets, and security group rules that may affect notebook or inference connectivity.

best_practices: Use least-privilege Huawei Cloud credentials for the exact ModelArts tasks required.
Ask for explicit confirmation before create, update, delete, start, stop, or authorization actions.
Review returned resource IDs and regions before using them in follow-up operations.
anti_patterns: Do not run broad administrative prompts with production credentials unless the scope is clear.
Do not pass raw AK/SK values through chat messages or logs.
Do not create training jobs from untrusted images or unreviewed commands.

faq.question: What does this skill manage?
faq.answer: It manages Huawei Cloud ModelArts notebooks, training jobs, inference services, pools, workspaces, VPC resources, KMS keypairs, SWR images, and Lite Server resources.

faq.question: Does it need cloud credentials?
faq.answer: Yes. It needs a ModelArts Notebook session or Huawei Cloud AK/SK credentials with the required permissions.

faq.question: Can it change or delete resources?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes create, update, start, stop, delete, authorization, and batch operation modules.

faq.question: Does it make network requests?
faq.answer: Yes. It sends signed requests to Huawei Cloud service endpoints for ModelArts, VPC, KMS, and SWR operations.

faq.question: Is this only for Claude?
faq.answer: No. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What should teams review before using it?
faq.answer: Review credential scope, allowed regions, destructive operations, training commands, and authorization changes before production use.
